_comment: basegame's reference micro map -- a small human town proving the engine's room/exit/chargen loop. See docs/plans/two_repo_purity.md Phase 7. Exits south from Crossroads Trail continue into demo_overworld.json (the macro map).

rooms.title: Millbrook - Town Square - Plaza
rooms.description: A modest square at the heart of town, paving stones worn smooth by years of foot traffic. A notice board stands near the well, and the town's few businesses front onto it from every side.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Ranger Post - Duty Room
rooms.description: A squat timber cabin bristling with maps of the surrounding wilds. A duty roster hangs by the door, and a rack of well-oiled gear waits for whoever draws the next patrol.

rooms.title: Millbrook - General Store - Counter
rooms.description: Shelves crowded floor to ceiling with dry goods, tools, and travel rations. The counter still bears the scars of a thousand small transactions.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Clinic - Ward
rooms.description: A plain, well-scrubbed room lined with cots and a supply cabinet. The smell of antiseptic hangs in the air; a chalkboard tracks who's on duty this shift.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Inn - Common Room
rooms.description: A low-ceilinged common room, tables scarred by mugs and elbows, a fire banked low in the hearth. It smells like woodsmoke and somebody's stew.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Warehouse - Loading Dock
rooms.description: Crates and pallets stacked in uneven rows, a loading dock open to the street. Every shipment in or out of town passes through here first.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Post Office - Counter
rooms.description: A narrow counter and a wall of cubbies. The clerk's stamp sits beside a stack of blank envelopes; letters leave town from here.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Crossroads Trail - Trailhead
rooms.description: The last cobblestones give way to packed dirt here, where the town's streets thin out into the trail proper. Open country waits south of the marker post.
